messages.speaker: me
messages.text: we actually shipped. still waiting for it to feel real

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: it shipped!! i refreshed the deploy page like six times just to watch it say green 🙂

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: green and everything. have you dared to look at the error dashboard yet

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: not since the release notes went out. tomorrow's problem. tonight is a bar problem

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: marta booked the corner table for seven

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: i'm already holding my coat. saving the speech for after the second drink

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: there is going to be a speech

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: a small one. mostly names i'll get wrong and one very serious point about the coffee machine

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: please do not put the coffee machine in the launch speech

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: too late. it's structure now. problem, machine, resolution

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: we're out front, come down whenever

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: walking. if anyone asks, i did not almost deploy to prod on a friday in july 😅

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: atmos says she's pre-ordered you a gin

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: she knows me too well. five minutes

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: morning. i survived the speech and only called the coffee machine by the intern's name once

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: i heard about that from three different people already

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: as long as the version numbers are right nobody gets to judge my appliance names

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: also did marketing ever fix the banner typo, or did we ship that?

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: tom fixed it yesterday, it goes out with tonight's content push

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: good. 'browswer' was starting to feel like a pet

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: you could've flagged it in june like a normal person

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: and miss the satisfaction of it getting fixed at the eleventh hour? never

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: heading into roadmap review — want me to grab a retro slot for thursday?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: yes please, right after lunch. and cap it at 45 minutes or nobody stays awake

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: deal, invite incoming

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: put 'no laptops' in the description. retro runners of the world, know your power 🙂

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: retro prep: i can take the 'what went wrong' half, want notes duty or the wins?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: notes for me. i take them fast and my handwriting has an air of authority nobody argues with

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: done. you're also on funnel numbers

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: already pulled — plus the support tag breakdown, which is the only slide anyone will remember

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: marta wants a one-line quote from each of us for the all-hands

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: 'we shipped the thing and the thing stayed shipped.' i've been sitting on that for a week

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: honest. i'll take it

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: should we invite priya? she ran the migration and nobody ever invites her to anything

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: yes obviously, adding her now

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: good. agenda: wins, disasters, one lesson, coffee machine tribute. 45 minutes

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: invite sent. priya replied 'about time'

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: then the tribute is partly hers 🙂
